description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderDelivery" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-delivery">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerOrder" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderDelivery">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderDelivery" name="Order delivery process" processRef="Process_OrderDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PostDeliveryActions" name="Post-delivery actions" processRef="Process_PostDeliveryActions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerOrder" name="Customer order" messageRef="Message_CustomerOrder" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return after delivery" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderDelivery" name="Order delivery" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Customer places an order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ChannelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerOrder" messageRef="Message_CustomerOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelSplit" name="Order channel?" default="Flow_Channel_Phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ChannelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channel_Online</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channel_Phone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelMerge" name="Converge order channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channel_Online</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channel_Phone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Automatically generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Warehouse team picks and packs the items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandOver_SendTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandOver_SendTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendTracking_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendTracking_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_EndDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Shipment successfully delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_EndDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ChannelSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Online" name="Online platform" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel = 'online'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Phone" name="Over the phone" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_GenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOver_SendTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTracking_Monitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_EndDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PostDeliveryActions" name="Post-delivery customer feedback or returns" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return received after delivery">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackOrReturn_TakeAction</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeFurtherAction" name="Take further action on customer feedback or return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackOrReturn_TakeAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TakeAction_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostDeliveryAction" name="Further action completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TakeAction_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackOrReturn_TakeAction" sourceRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_TakeFurtherAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeAction_End" sourceRef="Task_TakeFurtherAction" targetRef="EndEvent_PostDeliveryAction"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
